messages:
Sara: customer in SG hitting intermittent 500s and latency spikes. console shows region=ap-southeast-1 but runtime headers show x-serving-pop=us-central1. sample req ids: r_0a1b2c3d, r_0a1b2c3e
Ben: can you paste the curl + response headers + any gateway logs? cc @Evan
Sara: repro from a Singapore VM (to match customer network):
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
x-request-id: r_0a1b2c3d
x-serving-pop: us-central1
x-console-region: ap-southeast-1

# sometimes returns 200 but latency 300-700ms and x-serving-pop still us-central1
```
Sara: attaching console screenshot showing route primary=AP-SG for this project. :confused:
Evan: quick hypothesis: routing fallback sent traffic to us-central due to transient capacity issues. the console UI displays the configured primary region, not the effective last-served pop. need to verify telemetry path.
logs-bot: matched r_0a1b2c3d across edge, routing, runtime logs:
```
edge-gw | ts=2026-03-15T10:12:05Z | req=r_0a1b2c3d | src=sg-node-12 | route=proj-987-route
routing | ts=2026-03-15T10:12:05Z | req=r_0a1b2c3d | chosen_pop=us-central1 | reason=capacity-fallback
runtime | ts=2026-03-15T10:12:05Z | req=r_0a1b2c3d | err=kv-cache-miss | status=500
```
Ben: checked infra metrics — ap-sgd serving pool had two nodes OOM/reboot at ~10:11 UTC, autoscaler drained and we routed to fallback pops for ~3m. routing decision is expected. console aggregation didn't ingest fallback path as "last seen".
Anna: finance flagged billing discrepancy — some requests charged at ap-southeast pricing but were actually served in us-central. need list of impacted request IDs + timestamps for reconciliation.
Ben: I'll export the hits for that window. logs-bot: exported CSV to /shared/billing/impacted_1760329925.csv
Evan: suggested product change: surface an explicit "effective-serving-pop" in the console route detail (short-term flag) and add x-routing-reason header from the edge when fallback happens (e.g., x-routing-reason: capacity-fallback). both will help debugging and billing reconciliation.
David: repro plan for staging to validate and quantify cache-warmup errors: 1) pin route to ap-southeast-1 2) throttle ap-sgd pool (available_nodes=0) 3) fire 100 concurrent requests from SG VM and capture x-serving-pop + error rate.
Evan: ran the above in staging — header flips to us-central1 on failover and we observed ~2-4% 500s during warmup attributable to KV cache misses. stacktrace points to cache pressure on cross-pop cold starts.
Anna: customer comms: acknowledge fallback caused cross-pop serving and transient errors, provide CSV and planned mitigations. Finance will reconcile charges once Ben's export is in.
Ben: created INFRA-4821 for ap-sgd node OOMs and alerted ops for hardware/driver diagnostics.
Sara: drafting customer message, attaching repro logs and CSV; will post for Anna sign-off. :thumbsup:
Ben: short-term runbook actions: add console flag for "last served pop" (prod UI) and add billing reconciliation rule to prefer runtime serving_pop if present.
Evan: longer-term: unify console aggregation to prefer recent runtime telemetry (effective pop), and add x-routing-reason header from edge-gw so downstream tooling/clients see why fallback occurred.
deploy-bot: rolling-deploy infra/autoscaler v2.14.1 completed 2026-03-15T10:20:00Z
logs-bot: CSV saved to /shared/billing/impacted_1760329925.csv
David: good triage. I'll close once billing confirms. :white_check_mark:
